name: Self-Fulfilling Prophecies
excerpt: Self-Fulfilling Prophecies are expectations that subconsciously influence reality.
notes: Self-Fulfilling Prophecies are one of the five distortions in perceptions. They involve expectations that can subconsciously direct reality, impacting organizational and employee behavior.
context_summary:
- Involves expectations that influence reality
- Affects organizational behavior
- Affects employee behavior
- Directs reality subconsciously
